features.label: Lensed background structures
features.description: Small stretched and curved shapes around the massive cluster are candidate signatures of gravitational lensing.

explanation: MACS J0717 bends and magnifies light from more distant background objects, turning the cluster into a natural telescope.
colorMethod: Hubble's processed color separates sources, but lensing is read primarily from distorted geometry and confirmed through analysis.
whyItMatters: This reading separates what the image shows directly from what instruments, processing and context allow us to infer.
